test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Security**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Security **refers to the state of being protected or safe from harm, danger, or threats.
 
• It involves safeguarding against potential threats, whether physical, digital, or otherwise, to maintain a sense of well-being and stability.
 
• Thus, "**Security**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• Grammatically, it fits the sentence structure as it is a noun that can be used to describe a situation or condition.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Emergency**" refers to a sudden and unexpected situation that requires immediate action.
 
• "**Crisis**" refers to a time of intense difficulty or danger.
 
• "**Forces**" can refer to military personnel or physical strength.
